sources.notes: Original concept inspected at full resolution. Retain long zoned worm and paired rows. Override concept pointed rear with blunt rounded unspined posterior and small terminal aperture; no tail appendages. Concept long-spike count not reliable: build exactly25 radial long scalids at middle of proboscis. Reduce inflated spiny anterior bulb toward continuous tapered trunk, preserve distinct anterior short-spine, annulated middle, papillate posterior and smooth rear zones. Paired papilla rows continue across dorsal middle/posterior, short trunk spines remain elsewhere until unspined rear. Complete real volumes, mouth recessed, no painted-disc mouth. No substrate.
